title: Tailwise Autoship Delivery Calendar: Frequencies, Ship Days and Cutoffs
content:
Every Tailwise Autoship program runs on its own delivery calendar. The fulfillment calendar below fixes, per program, which delivery frequencies can be set, on which weekdays a shipment may leave the fulfillment center, how far ahead a change must be requested, and how many carrier transit days the program promises after the ship date.

## Calendar

| | Everyday | Litter & Bulk | Fresh & Frozen | Custom Meal Plan | Pharmacy | Compounded Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shortest frequency (weeks) | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 4 | 4 |
| Longest frequency (weeks) | 26 | 26 | 8 | 4 | 26 | 13 |
| Frequency step (weeks) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Ship weekdays | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri | Mon, Tue, Wed | Mon, Tue | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu |
| Change cutoff (calendar days before the next ship date) | 1 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 3 | 5 |
| Promised carrier transit after the ship date (days) | 2 | 4 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 |

## Definitions

1. **Frequency range and step.** A frequency can be set from the shortest to the longest figure shown, and it must be a whole multiple of the step. With a step of 1 week on every program, any whole number of weeks inside the range qualifies.
2. **Ship weekdays.** The weekdays on which a shipment of the program may leave the fulfillment center.
3. **Change cutoff.** A change, skip or cancellation affects the upcoming shipment only when requested at least this many calendar days before its next ship date.
4. **Promised transit.** The carrier transit days the program promises after the ship date.

## Points of judgement

- **Is 10 weeks a settable frequency?** On Autoship Everyday, Autoship Litter & Bulk, Autoship Pharmacy and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy, yes: it lies inside their ranges. On Autoship Fresh & Frozen (longest 8 weeks) and Autoship Custom Meal Plan (longest 4 weeks), no.
- **Is 1 week settable on Autoship Litter & Bulk?** No: its shortest frequency is 2 weeks.
- **Is 3 weeks settable on Autoship Pharmacy?** No: its shortest frequency is 4 weeks.
- **Can an Autoship Custom Meal Plan shipment leave on a Wednesday?** No: that program ships on Monday and Tuesday only.
